From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia

Ugandan-born South African actor (1948–2019)

This article is about the Ugandan actor. For the American musician with a similar name, see [Lisa Marie Presley](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lisa_Marie_Presley "Lisa Marie Presley").

| Danny Keogh |

| Born | (1948-03-03)3 March 1948 [Kampala](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kampala,_Uganda "Kampala, Uganda"), [Protectorate of Uganda](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Protectorate_of_Uganda "Protectorate of Uganda") |
| Died | 23 July 2019(2019-07-23) (aged 71) |

**Danny Keogh** (3 March 1948 – 23 July 2019)[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Danny_Keogh#cite_note-1) was a Ugandan-born South African actor known for his roles in South African television programs such as _Known Gods_,[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Danny_Keogh#cite_note-2)_Interrogation Room_, and Julius Galt in _[Charlie Jade](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Charlie\_Jade "Charlie Jade")_.[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Danny_Keogh#cite_note-3)

He was born on 3 March 1948 in [Kampala](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kampala "Kampala"), Uganda.[[4]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Danny_Keogh#cite_note-4)

Danny Keogh played King Dunchaid in the film _[Northmen: A Viking Saga](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Northmen:\_A\_Viking\_Saga "Northmen: A Viking Saga")_.[[5]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Danny_Keogh#cite_note-5)
